description: This file defines a Java interface 'ExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider' responsible for retrieving tenant and auth-id information from an execution context, specifically within the context of the Eclipse Hono project. It declares a generic method 'get' that returns a Future resolving to a TenantObjectWithAuthId, given an execution context and an optional OpenTracing span context.

classes.name: ExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A Java interface providing a contract for obtaining tenant and authentication ID information from an execution context within the Hono service architecture. It is generic over types extending ExecutionContext.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth-id information from the provided execution context, optionally utilizing an OpenTracing span context. Returns a Future that resolves to a TenantObjectWithAuthId, with failure cases documented in comments.
